description: Repairs r-def-cat-txn/cat-xproc-drop-table-under-reader: after the fourth DROP TABLE returned no error both processes still listed T from cached TableDefs, and no independent read followed. Process A creates a new ACCDB with T, reopens it shared and holds a snapshot, a dynaset and a table-type recordset on T, each on row 1, and a TableDef object. Process B tries DROP TABLE T, then ALTER TABLE T ADD COLUMN W LONG; A moves each recordset one row and closes the snapshot; B tries DROP TABLE T again; A closes the others and releases the TableDef; B tries a last DROP TABLE T. DBEngine.Errors is read right before and after each of B's statements. At the end each process lists the refreshed TableDefs and runs SELECT * FROM T, and A also does so through a second Database.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
